data.name: Dopamine
data.subtitle: Semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 15 – 26
data.localizedDescription: Dopamine is the modern semi-untethered, rootless jailbreak for iOS and iPadOS 15.0 through 26.0.1. It bootstraps a Procursus environment (Sileo and friends) on supported arm64e and arm64 devices, keeps passcode, Touch ID/Face ID and Apple Pay working, and hides its filesystem changes well enough to stay through a userspace reboot. This entry tracks the official Dopamine app the developer publishes on GitHub Releases.
data.versionDescription:
Dopamine 3.0.11 | Dopamine

- Fix support for iOS 26.0 beta 1 [3.0.1 regression]
- Fix boot logo not being cleaned up correctly before backboardd starts, fixes framebuffer getting stuck with it's last content during sbreload when a boot logo is used (now the screen will correctly fade to a black screen like when no boot logo is used)
- Update opainject and litehook

compatibility.notes: Official unsigned IPA from opa334/Dopamine (the upstream also publishes an identical .tipa for TrollStore; this source serves the .ipa). Supported firmware and device lists change between releases — check the release notes before updating. Sign with your own certificate through SideStore, AltStore, Feather or ESign.
